Title: Karnivool + Wheel
Description:
‘It's a new day’, because Karnivool are returning to our country! The Australian prog-rock band played at the Metal Dome at Graspop Metal Meeting in 2024 and, this spring, at a sold-out De Casino in Sint-Niklaas.

Heavy riffs, complex rhythms and compelling melodies: Karnivool have been among Australia’s most influential rock bands for over twenty years. With the platinum-selling albums ‘Themata’, ‘Sound Awake’ and the number one album ‘Asymmetry’, as well as songs such as “Simple Boy”, “We Are” and “Goliath”, the band has built up a loyal fanbase across the globe.

This has earned them, amongst other things, a sold-out show at the Roundhouse in London and appearances at some of the world’s biggest metal festivals. After a twelve-year wait, Karnivool finally released their fourth album, ‘In Verses’, earlier this year. Together with their long-standing producer Forrester Savell, they experimented endlessly in their studio in Perth. The result is ten tracks about frustration, liberation and rediscovering who you are. For loyal fans, it’s a love letter; for newcomers, the perfect introduction to the band.

The Finnish prog-metal band Wheel will be the support act.
